title: E-commerce Product and Order Analysis
problem_statement: An e-commerce product team needs to understand how acquisition channel, device, and product interactions relate to conversion and revenue.
questions: Which channel-device combinations have strong conversion?
How does product depth relate to order value?
Where does revenue concentration create risk?
hypotheses: Returning direct traffic converts at a higher rate.
Sessions with more product views have higher order value.
recommendations: Prioritize high-impact channel-device journeys for qualitative review.
Instrument product-view and checkout events consistently before funnel optimization.
